name: Show data root selector when opening rowbly in a new directory
description:
Whenever I open rowbly in a directory that does not have a `.rowbly` folder, I am prompted to initialize the directory with Rowbly and I have no other option.

Instead, I should see a list of my data roots (stored in `$HOME/.rowblyrc.json`) and at the bottom I should have an option to initialize the current directory with Rowbly.
